name: Atuin
description: Searches, syncs and resumes your shell history and coding-agent sessions across machines, with a built-in MCP server so agents can recall past work.

skills.name: Search Shell History
skills.description: Searches shell history by command, exit code, directory, host and time from a Ctrl-R pane or the atuin search CLI.

skills.name: Resume Agent Threads
skills.description: Resumes or forks Claude Code and Codex sessions on another machine or in another agent harness with atuin resume.

skills.name: Search Agent Threads
skills.description: Searches past agent sessions captured on any of your machines with atuin threads search to find earlier work.

skills.name: Agent History MCP
skills.description: Answers agent questions about earlier sessions and decisions through the built-in atuin mcp server for Claude Code and Codex.

skills.name: Encrypted Sync
skills.description: Syncs shell history and agent sessions across machines end-to-end encrypted, via Atuin's service or a self-hosted server.
